Get a HUGE chest pump in just 5 minutes with this no-equipment military calisthenics chest workout. Five push-up variations, one minute each, and ZERO REST.
TRAIN WITH ME:
THE 5-MINUTE CHEST WORKOUT
5 EXERCISES. 5 MINUTES. NO REST.
This quick bodyweight chest workout is designed to hammer your chest, shoulders, and triceps while challenging your muscular endurance. No weights, no machines, and no gym required.
Don’t worry about matching my rep count. Focus on quality reps, maintain good form, and keep working for the entire minute. Modify as necessary—but keep moving.
